doji.label: Doji
doji.description: Open and close land almost on top of each other — the session ended where it began, a tug of war with no winner.

hammer.label: Hammer
hammer.description: A small body near the top of the range with a long lower wick, after a decline — sellers pushed price down and buyers pushed it back.

shooting_star.label: Shooting star
shooting_star.description: A small body near the bottom of the range with a long upper wick, after a rise — buyers pushed price up and sellers pushed it back.

bullish_engulfing.label: Bullish engulfing
bullish_engulfing.description: A rising candle whose body fully swallows the prior falling candle's body — often read as buyers overwhelming the prior day's sellers.

bearish_engulfing.label: Bearish engulfing
bearish_engulfing.description: A falling candle whose body fully swallows the prior rising candle's body.

piercing_line.label: Piercing line
piercing_line.description: A falling candle followed by a rising candle that opens below the prior low and closes above its midpoint.

dark_cloud_cover.label: Dark cloud cover
dark_cloud_cover.description: A rising candle followed by a falling candle that opens above the prior high and closes below its midpoint.

morning_star.label: Morning star
morning_star.description: Three candles: a fall, a small-bodied pause, then a rise closing back into the first candle's body — a textbook reversal shape.

evening_star.label: Evening star
evening_star.description: The mirror of the morning star: a rise, a pause, then a fall.

three_white_soldiers.label: Three white soldiers
three_white_soldiers.description: Three consecutive rising candles, each closing higher than the last with small upper wicks — read as sustained buying pressure.

three_black_crows.label: Three black crows
three_black_crows.description: The mirror of three white soldiers: three consecutive falling candles.
